'''Arch Canyon''', also known as '''Arch Mesa''', on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], was a canyon with natural stone arches that spanned its width. Located just south of [[Beggar's Canyon/Legends|Beggar's Canyon]], it was the tenth leg of the [[Mos Espa Circuit|Mos Espa Racetrack]].

{{Nature-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Arch_Canyon.png|thumb|left|180px|Arch Canyon during the Boonta Eve Classic]]
The Arch Canyon is one of many designated planetary regions in the [[Wikipedia:MMORPG|MMORPG]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]''. However, in the game it is identified as the "Arch Mesa".
